remarks: ONE ACRE. OPEN SPACE. MATURE TREES. YOUR VISION STARTS HERE. Discover the possibilities at 4100 N French Rd in East Amherst, an approximately 1-acre vacant residential lot in the Williamsville School District. Aerial views showcase a long, deep parcel with a broad open grassy interior framed by mature trees, offering natural character and a sense of separation within an established residential setting. With direct frontage on N French Road and convenient access to Transit Rd  and the broader East Amherst and Williamsville area, this property presents an opportunity to explore plans for a custom home tailored to your needs. Bring your builder, walk the land, and imagine what could take shape here
